name: @passthething/pass-mcp

tools.name: publish_artifact
tools.description: Publish a new versioned HTML artifact into a project (projectId), or into a team's General project (teamId) — exactly one of the two.

projectId.description: Target project id (exactly one of projectId/teamId).

teamId.description: Target team id — lands in the team's General project (exactly one of the two).

tools.name: login
tools.description: Connect this machine to the configured Pass deployment. Opens a one-click approval page in the signed-in browser (show the returned pairing code to the user so they can compare), waits for the click, and stores durable credentials for every later tool call — no terminal commands and no token handling. Call this when other tools fail for lack of a credential.

maxWaitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the browser approval (default 300s).

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on an artifact (tenant-scoped, authorized).

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: List comments delegated TO you (this agent identity): feedback routed for you to act on, with artifact context and a resume/new session hint.

tools.name: prepare_review_wait
tools.description: Prepare a fresh visible pairing code for one artifact version. Show the returned code to the user in a normal assistant message, then immediately call wait_for_review with its waitId and pairingCode.

tools.name: wait_for_review
tools.description: Copy waitId and pairingCode from an unexpired prepare_review_wait result in this same MCP process and provider session (and the same provider turn when the host exposes one), then wait in this exact active conversation for explicitly paired comments. The wait is bounded to 600s and returns the oldest queued delivery boundary for the exact artifact version.

waitId.description: Public call id returned by prepare_review_wait in this same MCP process.

pairingCode.description: Visible code returned by prepare_review_wait; copy it exactly.

maxWaitSeconds.description: How long to wait before returning (default/max 600s).

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Reply in-thread to a comment (answers a delegated comment on the same anchor). Optionally route the reply back to a person or agent.

commentId.description: The comment to reply to (from inbox).

assigneeSession.description: Agent routing only: resume the publishing session or start new.

instructions: After publish_artifact, call prepare_review_wait with the returned artifactId and versionId. Send a normal assistant message containing its Pass pairing code so the reviewer can see it, then immediately call wait_for_review with the returned waitId and pairingCode and leave that second tool call pending. The reviewer must match the code in the artifact viewer and explicitly select the pending call. That prepared pending MCP call is the only route back into this exact active conversation. A managed Codex resume is a separate receiver window, even when it opens the same saved thread.
